note: The Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan states on its Monetary Policy page that the ngultrum has been pegged at par to the Indian rupee since its introduction in 1974; read 2026-10-30.

sources.title: Monetary Policy (Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan)
sources.said: Bhutan’s monetary policy is that of Exchange Rate Targeting - since the introduction of the Ngultrum in 1974, the Ngultrum has been pegged at par to the Indian Rupee, which serves as the nominal anchor.
